items.heading: At 25, Almost Any Direction
items.text: At 25, almost any direction is cheap to test. By 40, a full reset gets genuinely expensive. Thirty sits in the middle: still early enough that a real change is realistic, but late enough that the years already invested and the years still ahead both start to matter in the decision.
